# The kernel on the owner's low-voicing reference (generated by tune_test.py)

Nothing is fitted to a note. Window conductance by the kernel's formula (eta_w 0.9). *Common shift*: how far the whole scale lies from A4..F6 at the size of the file. *Left over*: the 13 notes after that one shift is taken out; this does not change when the body is scaled. Order of opening: the Asian system.
